name: [⭐🏥⭐] My Hospital
desc:
🖌️ Design, Build & Manage Your Own Hospital Empire 🏥. 

Quickly upgrade your hospital equipment to cope with demand, complete the challenges ✔️ and unlock new cures 🔓 on your quest to be the best ⭐.

Features:

🏗️ Build & decorate your hospital exactly how you like it.
🔓Unlock new cures & expand your hospital
👩‍⚕️ Hire & manage staff or play with friends
🚑 Pick-up patients in your ambulance & battle other players
& a whole lot more...

Enjoyed the game? Don't forget to leave a Thumbs Up 👍 & Favourite ⭐. Thank you 🙏!

Be sure to join our Group to use the free ATM and Token Dispensers inside the game:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/8300205/Nexo-Games-Official#!/about
